headline: Navy Rushes Special Tracking Device To Check Course of Russian Satellite
excerpt: The Naval Research Laboratory today rushed an emergency-built tracking rig to its Minitrack facility at Blossom Point, Md., in an effort to get the first accurate measurement of the orbit and location of the Russian satellite.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from LOC OCR; obvious OCR errors corrected.

headline: Pioneer Satellite Sent 560 Miles High By Reds
excerpt: A Soviet-launched artificial moon roared around the earth today circling the globe every 95 minutes 560 miles out in space.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from LOC OCR; obvious OCR errors corrected.

headline: Diplomatic "Defeat" In First Satellite?
excerpt: State department officials privately admitted Saturday that Russia dealt the U. S. a tremendous diplomatic defeat in launching the first earth satellite.

headline: TO VERIFY: front-page U.N. session report (headline not legible in OCR)
excerpt: Behind-scenes talks between United States Ambassador Adlai E. Stevenson and Soviet Deputy Foreign Minister Valerian Zorin brought accord on such knotty issues as arrangements for negotiations on disarmament and outer space and the choosing of a successor for Mr. Hammarskjold.
excerpt_note: Passage confirmed in LOC OCR of page A-1. Which article it belongs to, and its headline, need checking against the page image.

headline: Space Flights of A-Arms Are Outlawed by U. N.
excerpt: The United Nations General Assembly today outlawed the orbiting of nuclear weapons and other weapons of mass destruction in outer space.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from LOC OCR; obvious OCR errors corrected. The resolution is hortatory; 'outlawed' is the paper's word.

headline: New U. S., Russian Pact First Step at Space Law
byline: William R. Frye (Special to The Star)
excerpt: The United States and the Soviet Union have agreed on a historic first step toward placing outer space under a rule of law.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from LOC OCR. The article notes the declaration 'will not carry the binding force of a treaty'.

headline: Space Pacts On Liability Sought by U. S.
excerpt: Informed diplomats said today the resolution would have the General Assembly ask the Committee on Peaceful Uses of Outer Space to "arrange for the early preparation of appropriate international agreements on liability for damages caused by space vehicles and on assistance to and return of astronauts and space vehicles."
excerpt_note: Transcribed from LOC OCR; obvious OCR errors corrected. Headline reads '11. S.' in OCR.

page: image 18 (editorial page; page number TO VERIFY)
headline: TO VERIFY: editorial (headline not identified in OCR)
excerpt: Another encouraging fact is that Moscow and Washington have worked out an accord on the broad legal principles that should govern the exploration and exploitation of space.
excerpt_note: Passage confirmed in LOC OCR; headline needs checking against the page image.

headline: Sowjet-Unie wil ruimteverdrag
excerpt: De maan en andere planeten mogen slechts voor vreedzame doeleinden worden gebruikt.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from KB OCR; OCR errors corrected.
translation: The moon and other planets may be used only for peaceful purposes.

headline: Goldberg tevreden over voorwaarden ruimtevaartverdrag
headline_en: Goldberg satisfied with terms of space treaty
excerpt: ...dat er met de Sowjet-Unie een grotere mate van overeenstemming is bereikt over de voorwaarden voor een ruimtevaartverdrag dan aanvankelijk leek.
translation: ...that a greater measure of agreement had been reached with the Soviet Union on the terms of a space treaty than had at first appeared.

headline: Akkoord in UNO: Ruimte verboden voor kernwapens
headline_en: Agreement at the UN: space closed to nuclear weapons
deck: Vrij toegang op de maan (Free access to the moon)
excerpt: Johnson noemde het historische verdrag ... een belangrijke stap naar vrede en „de belangrijkste ontwikkeling in de bewapeningsbeperking sinds het kernstopverdrag van 1963".
excerpt_note: Transcribed from KB OCR. Compare Johnson's English wording in the 8 December 1966 statement.
translation: Johnson called the historic treaty ... an important step toward peace and "the most important development in arms limitation since the test-ban treaty of 1963".

headline: Nieuw akkoord over ruimte: Kernwapens verbannen — Vrije toegang tot hemellichamen
headline_en: New agreement on space: nuclear weapons banned; free access to celestial bodies
excerpt: De maan en andere hemellichamen dienen alle staten, die het verdrag ondertekenen, uitsluitend te gebruiken voor vreedzame doeleinden.
excerpt_note: KB OCR is heavily garbled at this point; text reconstructed from OCR. Check against the page image before publishing.
translation: All states that sign the treaty are to use the moon and other celestial bodies exclusively for peaceful purposes.

headline: UNO aanvaardt ruimteverdrag
excerpt: Het verdrag werd geprezen als een mijlpaal in de samenwerking tussen Amerika en Rusland voor vrede in het atoomtijdperk.
translation: The treaty was hailed as a milestone in cooperation between America and Russia for peace in the atomic age.

headline: Ruimteverdrag getekend
excerpt: Voor de Sowjet-Unie tekende minister van Buitenlandse Zaken Gromyko, voor de V.S. en Engeland de ambassadeurs. De premier van de Sowjet-Unie Kosygin woonde plechtigheid bij.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from KB OCR. The paper leads with the Moscow ceremony; it also notes entry into force after ratification by at least five states.
translation: Foreign Minister Gromyko signed for the Soviet Union, the ambassadors for the U.S. and Britain. Soviet Premier Kosygin attended the ceremony.

headline: Kernachtig gebaar
excerpt: Het nieuwe verdrag is de eerste ontwapeningsovereenkomst in lange jaren waarmee Frankrijk wèl akkoord zal gaan.
translation: The new treaty is the first disarmament agreement in many years that France will actually accept.

headline: Ook Nederland ondertekent ruimteverdrag
headline_en: The Netherlands also signs space treaty
excerpt: Het verdrag verklaart dat de ruimte en de hemellichamen niet mogen worden toegeëigend.
excerpt_note: Transcribed from KB OCR. The article goes on to summarise cooperation, jurisdiction, liability and assistance provisions.
translation: The treaty declares that space and the celestial bodies may not be appropriated.

headline: Frankrijk treedt toe tot ruimteverdrag
excerpt: Frankrijk zal toetreden tot het internationale verdrag inzake het gebruik van de ruimte voor louter vreedzame doeleinden, ondanks de boycot door dit land van het ontwapeningsoverleg in Genève.
translation: France will accede to the international treaty on the use of space for purely peaceful purposes, despite its boycott of the disarmament talks in Geneva.

headline: Verbodsverdrag op militaire activiteit in ruimte van kracht
headline_en: Treaty banning military activity in space enters into force
excerpt_note: OCR too garbled to quote safely. Paraphrase: the treaty entered into force with the deposit of ratifications by five governments including the US, USSR and UK; ceremonies were held in Moscow, Washington and London; at the White House Johnson called it a hopeful sign that war and hatred are not inevitable, paid tribute to the Soviet Union for launching the first Sputnik ten years earlier, and renewed his call for cooperation with the Russians in space research.
